subject: Pre-cutover: VPC cutover red-team checklist, firebreaks & smoke evidence
messages:
From: Marcus Lin <marcus@redwood.com>
To: Irene Choi <irene@redwood.com>, Mina Haddad <mina@redwood.com>
Cc: Laura Bennett <laura@redwood.com>, ops@acme.acme
Date: Fri, 16 Mar 2028 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Pre-cutover: VPC cutover red-team checklist, firebreaks & smoke evidence

Team —

We have one dry run left before the ACME VPC cutover window next Saturday. This thread is to consolidate the red-team-style acceptance checks, the operational "firebreaks" we discussed, and where the smoke evidence will be collected so compliance can sign off. High-level asks:

- Confirm preflight gating items below are owned and green by EOD tomorrow (Irene/Mina).
- Attachments: vpc-cutover-redteam-checklist.pdf (detailed checks), runbook-step-9-kv-priming.txt (commands to warm KV caches), smoke-evidence-20280316.csv (template).
- If any red-team check fails, we execute the firebreak: immediate BGP withdraw to isolation Vlan and rollback to previous route table; see section 4 of the checklist.

Red-team checklist (summary):
1) ACL denylist verification — validate ingress/egress deny entries on edge NATs and perimeter LB (test vectors included in PDF).
2) BGP and transit health — simulate next-hop removal and ensure route failover occurs within 30s without blackholing customer traffic.
3) KV-cache priming — run step-9 script and confirm kv.cache.hit_ratio >= 0.75 for the priming keys.
4) Telemetry probes — synthetic user probes (3 regions) must show <120ms p50 for first-byte after priming.
5) Observability pipeline — logs and traces for the cutover tag must reach retention sink within 10 minutes after probe.
6) Escape (firebreak) plan — manual trip to drain and reroute traffic to standby cluster; documented doc link in attachments.

Proposed schedule for the dry run (tomorrow):
- 09:00-09:20 PST: baseline telemetry capture
- 09:20-09:45 PST: run red-team checklist steps 1-3 (Irene leads)
- 09:45-10:00 PST: KV priming and pings (Mina leads)
- 10:00-10:30 PST: telemetry reconciliation and artifact upload (Marcus/ops@acme.acme)

Please flag any missing steps. I left the full checklist in the PDF; this email contains the critical operational firebreak triggers we need to test.

--
Marcus Lin
Product Ops, Redwood Inference
marcus@redwood.com

From: Irene Choi <irene@redwood.com>
To: Marcus Lin <marcus@redwood.com>, Mina Haddad <mina@redwood.com>
Cc: Laura Bennett <laura@redwood.com>, ACME Infra <ops@acme.acme>
Date: Fri, 16 Mar 2028 10:05:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Pre-cutover: VPC cutover red-team checklist, firebreaks & smoke evidence

On Fri, Mar 16, 2028 at 09:12 AM Marcus Lin <marcus@redwood.com> wrote:
> Team —
>
> We have one dry run left before the ACME VPC cutover window next Saturday. This thread is to consolidate the red-team-style acceptance checks...

Thanks Marcus — I reviewed the PDF and annotated a few risk thresholds inline. Quick notes:

- ACL denylist verification: we'll run the denylist test harness (attached in drive link) that injects 8 probe IPs. If more than 2 probes return ACCEPT, we fail and invoke firebreak.
- BGP failover: I will simulate a next-hop withdraw from the transit edge; ops@acme.acme please confirm you can observe route withdrawals from your side.
- KV priming: Mina, can you confirm the priming key set for the ACME account? I want to avoid priming keys that collide with a live customer keyspace.
- Observability: I've added a quick checklist step to validate that the "cutover" tag is present in traces and that our log-forwarder shows zero 5xxs for the test window.

I've scheduled a 09:00 dry-run room and created a temporary warroom document in the shared drive (link below). I also added an explicit manual trigger for the firebreak in the runbook: if p95 latency > 850ms for more than 5 minutes or any data-plane 5xx spike > 1% we will execute the isolation.

Drive: https://drive.redwood.com/drive/folders/0Bz-cutover-acme-20280316

Irene
Sr. Reliability Engineer, Redwood Inference
irene@redwood.com

From: Mina Haddad <mina@redwood.com>
To: Marcus Lin <marcus@redwood.com>, Irene Choi <irene@redwood.com>
Cc: Laura Bennett <laura@redwood.com>, ACME Infra <ops@acme.acme>, Nimbus Cloud Support <cloud-svc@vendor.io>
Date: Fri, 16 Mar 2028 13:14:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Pre-cutover: VPC cutover red-team checklist, firebreaks & smoke evidence

Quick dry-run update — executed the red-team checklist in the staging replica and uploaded the smoke evidence CSV to the drive. Summary:

- ACL denylist test: PASS (8/8 probes denied).
- BGP withdrawal simulation: PASS (failover converged in 18s; no blackhole observed in synthetic path).
- KV priming: ran runbook-step-9-kv-priming.txt against the staging kv cluster. Results: kv.cache.hit_ratio=0.81 after priming window (see runbook output excerpt below).

--- runbook-step-9-kv-priming.txt excerpt ---
$ ./kv-prime --account acme --keys-file acme-priming-keys.txt --duration 300
Priming: 300 keys/sec for 300s
Final stats: requests=90000, hit=72900, hit_ratio=0.81
Latency p50=24ms p95=92ms p99=190ms
-------------------------------------------

- Telemetry probes: p50-first-byte measured 78ms (us-west), 102ms (us-east), 96ms (eu-west). All below the 120ms p50 threshold.
- Observability: log-forwarder delivery to the sink shows 0 missing events and cutover tag present on test traces.

I've attached the smoke-evidence-20280316.csv to the drive; it contains the probe IDs, timestamps, measured latencies, and the runbook command outputs. No 5xx spikes were observed.

Next steps:
1) Ops/ACME confirm they observed route withdraw on their side and no customer incidents.
2) Irene to validate denylist logs from perimeter devices and sign off on ACL gating.
3) Marcus/Laura to confirm the firebreak contact list and DocuSign approval for the rollback authority (if needed).

If all green, can we mark the preflight as accepted and proceed to the scheduled production cutover window?

Mina
SRE, Redwood Inference
mina@redwood.com

From: Laura Bennett <laura@redwood.com>
To: Marcus Lin <marcus@redwood.com>, Mina Haddad <mina@redwood.com>, Irene Choi <irene@redwood.com>
Cc: ops@acme.acme, Nimbus Cloud Support <cloud-svc@vendor.io>
Date: Fri, 16 Mar 2028 15:26:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Pre-cutover: VPC cutover red-team checklist, firebreaks & smoke evidence

Thanks all — received the dry-run report and the artifacts (I reviewed the CSV and the priming output). This is sufficient for compliance to accept the preflight.

Decision: PRE-FLIGHT ACCEPTED (greenlight for scheduled cutover). Conditions:
- Cutover window remains the scheduled 01:00-03:00 UTC next Saturday.
- Firebreak execution authority: on-call SRE (Mina) + Infra lead (Irene). If either executes the firebreak, treat as a failed cutover and start rollback runbook 4.x immediately.
- Post-cutover: collect smoke evidence within first 15 minutes and deliver a snapshot to compliance mailbox.

Please update the runbook to include the exact DocuSign rollback authority record (I'll attach the sign-off after I file it). Also ensure the contact list in the runbook has phone numbers (not just pager).

Laura Bennett
VP, Product Operations, Redwood Inference
laura@redwood.com
